source.name: JAKO AG Newsblog: 'JAKO präsentiert WM-Trikots der irakischen Nationalmannschaft'
source.note: Kit maker (JAKO AG launch announcement for the Iraq 2026 World Cup home, away and third kits; German article with an English section on the same page, hence the date shown only as 2026). JAKO's announcement is corroborated by the kit-launch coverage in the named press: Football Fashion and Footy Headlines (both 2026-05-22) and Iraqi News/INA (2026-05-23), which report the Iraqi Football Association unveiling the JAKO-made tournament kits. No commercial shirt sponsor: the launch reports describe only the Iraq FA badge, the Iraqi-flag collar and cuffs and JAKO's trademark shoulder logos on the white home shirt, with matching white shorts and socks (Football Fashion: 'Jako's signature dot detailing runs along the top of both sleeves, and the Iraqi Football Association badge sits on the right chest.'); no front, back, sleeve, shorts or patch sponsor appears in the JAKO launch photography. The JAKO article's title is 'JAKO präsentiert WM-Trikots der irakischen Nationalmannschaft'.
source.quote: The Iraqi national team will take to the pitch at the 2026 FIFA World Cup in new kits from JAKO.

summary: JAKO home kit for the 2026 World Cup (Iraq's first since 1986), released May 2026. No commercial shirt sponsors: JAKO's launch announcement and the kit-launch coverage (Football Fashion, Footy Headlines, 22 May 2026; Iraqi News/INA, 23 May 2026) describe only the Iraq FA badge, an Iraqi-flag collar and cuffs and JAKO's shoulder logos on the white home shirt, with matching white shorts and socks.
